title: RAAC | Website
description: RAAC is a company founded in 2012 that provides consultancy and auditing services with a commitment to quality, reliability and creativity. I built a custom static Next.js website for this client.

title: Tracefy | Backoffice
description: Tracefy provides a platform for fleet management and tracking. I built a Laravel backoffice used by the company's employees to automate their daily processes.

title: Tracefy | Infrastructure Migration
description: Tracefy ran a large fleet of unmanaged servers. I migrated their infrastructure to AWS and set up proper server management.

title: Tracefy | Infrastructure as Code
description: Tracefy's infrastructure was managed by hand. I migrated it to infrastructure as code with Terraform and Ansible, making it easier to manage and scale.

title: Tracefy | Socket Services
description: Tracefy had multiple socket services written in legacy PHP 5.6 with lots of duplication. I migrated them to modern PHP versions and refactored them to be DRY and easy to scale.

title: Tracefy | Docker to Kubernetes Migration
description: Tracefy's containers were managed with Docker Swarm. I migrated the workloads to Kubernetes, giving the team better management, scaling and deployment options.

title: Tracefy | PHP 7.0 to 8.2 & Laravel Upgrades
description: I upgraded Tracefy's PHP services from PHP 7.0 to 8.2 and brought multiple Laravel applications up to the latest version, unlocking modern language and framework features.

title: Tracefy | Dealershop
description: Tracefy had an old WordPress website built on the Sage theme. I co-developed a new dealer shop in WordPress, making it much easier to manage their dealerships.

title: Tracefy | Microservices
description: I split several monolithic applications into multiple microservices, making the platform more scalable and easier to maintain.

title: Tracefy | Business Metrics Monitoring
description: I migrated Tracefy's legacy monitoring to InfluxDB for business metrics, giving the team real-time insight into the platform.

title: Tracefy | Infrastructure Metrics Monitoring
description: I migrated the infrastructure metrics (memory, CPU) from InfluxDB to Prometheus and Grafana, providing a clear overview of the entire infrastructure.

title: Tracefy | Jasper API Integration
description: Many SIM management operations were done manually. I integrated the Jasper API to automate these operations, saving hours of work every week.
